Correct jack center/sleeve; distinct W1/W2; correct fuses and capacitor polarity; verified header orientation; no speaker-to-ground connection; all adapters continuity-tested; no exposed contacts or pinched wires.

Qualified builder uses a current-limited low-voltage bench supply for initial harness checks, then the selected brick. Connect/verify one branch at a time with servo mechanism kept safe. Record rail voltage and unexpected idle current. Do not create test shorts in the robot.

On actual 3A+, run normal approved motion, 16-pixel patterns at the initial brightness ceiling, duplex conversation and theme playback together. Record inlet/Pi/dongle minimum voltage and peak/steady current. Target ≥4.85 V at Pi under the tested load, never exceed 5.25 V on the 5 V system, and no fresh undervoltage/throttle flags or USB resets. These are prototype acceptance targets, not manufacturer certification thresholds.

Keep sustained normal-operation input at or below a design target of 4 A for the 5 A supply; capture transients separately. If that fails, revise architecture/connector ratings before increasing supply capacity. Confirm OEM leads, pigtails, fuses and connectors remain within their ratings and acceptable temperature rise after an hour of the heaviest intended workload.

A qualified bench test using controlled loads, away from the assembled robot, establishes supply limiting, branch fault behavior, fuse time/current performance and wire heating. This is still open; the BOM does not claim every fault clears a fuse.

Check clean music and speech at the intended listening volume, including bass/percussion, enclosure rattles and hiss. Repeat with the bottom cover fitted; inspect the microphone openings and speaker mounting if performance changes.

At 0.5 and 1 m: quiet/normal speech, room noise, motors active, interruption during playback and false self-responses. No documented hardware AEC is assumed. Do not accept a regression by silently switching to half-duplex.

Implement and verify the 16-address lighting profile, including the mouth zone, before powering the lighting assembly. On the actual 512 MB Pi 3A+, check the client, voice effects and motion together for memory exhaustion, sustained swapping, audio underruns and startup failures. Select USB input/output by stable device identity and verify automatic startup behavior.

Verify the 16-pixel address sequence, red/green/blue order and visible mouth end pixels, with no flicker during motion/audio. With external power disconnected, remove and refit the plain cover, reach the SD card, and operate each local disconnect without loading a board or pulling a wire. The character remains attached for routine base work.
